summary: Project updates use the control plane execution environment; jobs use the first set of: template, project default, job organization default, inventory organization default, DEFAULT_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT, GLOBAL_JOB_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENTS, any global one.
questions: Which execution environment does my job use?
What is the execution environment precedence order?
Which execution environment do project updates use?

answer_card.title: Execution environment precedence for jobs
answer_card.answer_md:
Jobs use the first one found:
1. `execution_environment` on the job template or inventory source
2. Project `default_environment`
3. Job organization `default_environment`
4. Inventory organization `default_environment`
5. `DEFAULT_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT` (`api/v2/settings/system/`)
6. Any image in `GLOBAL_JOB_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENTS`
7. Any other global execution environment

For 6 and 7 the most recently created wins. Project updates always use the control plane execution environment.
